items.text: A Delaware bankruptcy judge approved the rules for selling Character.AI, with Disney's $20 million bid as the opening offer, over objections from attorneys general in 41 states. He says he will likely appoint a privacy ombudsman for children's chat records.
Howard County, Maryland, made student assignments AI-free unless a teacher allows it, and barred staff from using AI for grading or counseling.
items.source_label: Baltimore Sun via Government Technology, Oct 30
